h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gorakhpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gorakhpur

items.pText: Gorakhpur sits on low, flat ground in eastern Uttar Pradesh, close to the Nepal border, with the Rapti river running past the city. Heavy monsoon rain here can leave school grounds and colony parks under water for days at a time. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for these sites at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,160 km away, and sends it to Gorakhpur by road.

Our buyers in this part of the state are mostly schools, housing colonies, hospitals with staff quarters and public gardens. For a site that floods, the level of the ground matters before the choice of slide or swing. We study your photos, ask where the water collects after a downpour and place the equipment on the highest, best-drained part of the plot. The layout drawing we send marks that spot along with the safe play area around each piece.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Keeping a play area usable through the monsoon

c: Raise the base of the play area above the surrounding ground and give it a gentle slope towards a drain or soak pit. Posts grouted in concrete stay firm in wet alluvial soil, where loose earth around a post can wash away. Galvanised pipe and roto-moulded plastic can stand in water without rusting, though springs and bearings deserve a look once the water drains. Avoid grass under the equipment, since it turns to slush by July.

items.q: Can playground equipment survive standing water during floods?
items.a: Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts do not rust in standing water. After the water drains, wash off the silt and check springs, bearings and bolts before children use the equipment again.

items.q: Do you deliver to eastern Uttar Pradesh?
items.a: Yes. We send orders from our Vasai factory to Gorakhpur and the surrounding districts by road. Our installation team or a dealer in North India then installs the equipment on your site.

items.q: Which installation method suits soft, wet soil?
items.a: Grouting, where each post is set in a concrete base. It holds the equipment firmly when the soil is soaked, and we mark every foundation point on the layout drawing.
